## Reading Data

Continuing with the same bike-share data and EDA from HW9. Redong them in `tidymodels` framework.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidymodels)
library(baguette)
library(ranger)
library(rpart.plot)
bike_data <- read_csv("https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv",locale = locale(encoding="latin1"))
bike_data

```

### EDA

Same cleanup as HW9: snake_case names, parse `date`, factor the three categorial columns, drop the non-functioning hours, then aggregate hourly to daily.

```{r}


bike <- bike_data 
names(bike) <- c("date","rented_count","hour","temp", "humidity","wind_speed","visibility","dew_point_temp","solar_radiation",
                 "rainfall","snowfall","seasons","holiday","functioning_day")

bike <- bike |>
  mutate(date = dmy(date)) |>
  mutate(across(c(seasons, holiday, functioning_day), as.factor)) |>
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes")

daily <- bike |>
  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) |>
  summarise(
    rented_count = sum(rented_count),
    rainfall = sum(rainfall),
    snowfall = sum(snowfall),
    temp = mean(temp),
    humidity = mean(humidity),
    wind_speed = mean(wind_speed),
    visibility = mean(visibility),
    dew_point_temp = mean(dew_point_temp),
    solar_radiation = mean(solar_radiation),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
daily

```


Let's summarize the daily bike data, plot

```{r}
summary(daily)

ggplot(daily, aes(x = seasons, y = rented_count)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(title = "Daily Bike Rentals by Season", x = "Season", y = "Total Daily Rentals")

ggplot(daily, aes(x = temp, y = rented_count, color = seasons)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "Daily Bike Rentals by Temperature", x = "Mean Daily Temp (C)", y = "Total Daily Rentals")

```

Let's correlate the data

```{r}

round(cor(daily |> select(where(is.numeric))),2)

```

temp vs rented_count has the highest correlation which is .75

## Split the Data

Let's split the data into training and testing 75/25 split using seasons as strata argument. using tidymodels. 10-folds CV on the training set.

```{r}
set.seed(558)
bike_split <- initial_split(daily, prop = 0.75, strata = seasons)
bike_train <- training(bike_split)
bike_test <- testing(bike_split)

bike_folds <- vfold_cv(bike_train, v = 10)

```

## Fitting MLR Models

### Recipes 

**Recipe 1**: 

- derive a weekday/weekend factor from `date`
- step_date creates brand new column that is date_dow, original date column remains untouched 
- use date_dow to further refine the factor to weekend and weekday 
- all numeric variables are normalized 
- step_dummy to create k-1 columns per each of the categorical column where k is number of factor levels 

```{r}
MLR_recipe1 <- recipe(rented_count ~ ., data = bike_train) |>
  update_role(date, new_role = "id") |>
  step_date(date, features = "dow") |>
  step_mutate(day_type =  factor(if_else(date_dow %in% c("Sat","Sun"), "weekend", "weekday"))) |>
  step_rm(date_dow) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(seasons, holiday, day_type)

MLR_recipe1
```


**Recipe 2**: 

- all the steps of recipe 1 
- Add in interactions between seasons and holiday, seasons and temp, temp and rainfall using `starts_with()` because `step_dummy` crates k-1 columns for seasons that start with `seasons`

```{r}
MLR_recipe2 <- recipe(rented_count ~ ., data = bike_train) |>
  update_role(date, new_role = "id") |>
  step_date(date, features = "dow") |>
  step_mutate(day_type =  factor(if_else(date_dow %in% c("Sat","Sun"), "weekend", "weekday"))) |>
  step_rm(date_dow) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(seasons, holiday, day_type) |>
  step_interact(~starts_with("seasons"):starts_with("holiday") + 
                 starts_with("seasons"):temp +
                 temp:rainfall)

MLR_recipe2
```

**Recipe 3**: 

- all the steps of recipe 2 
- Add in quadratic terms for the standardized temp and humidity variables.

```{r}

MLR_recipe3 <- recipe(rented_count ~ ., data = bike_train) |>
  update_role(date, new_role = "id") |>
  step_date(date, features = "dow") |>
  step_mutate(day_type =  factor(if_else(date_dow %in% c("Sat","Sun"), "weekend", "weekday"))) |>
  step_rm(date_dow) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(seasons, holiday, day_type) |>
  step_interact(~starts_with("seasons"):starts_with("holiday") + 
                 starts_with("seasons"):temp +
                 temp:rainfall) |>
  step_mutate(tetmp_sq = temp^2, humidity_sq = humidity^2)

MLR_recipe3


```

### Fit via 10-fold CV

```{r}
MLR_spec <- linear_reg() |>
  set_engine("lm")

MLR_workflow1 <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(MLR_recipe1) |>
  add_model(MLR_spec)

MLR_workflow2 <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(MLR_recipe2) |>
  add_model(MLR_spec)

MLR_workflow3 <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(MLR_recipe3) |>
  add_model(MLR_spec)

MLR_workflows <- list(recipe1 = MLR_workflow1, recipe2 = MLR_workflow2, recipe3 = MLR_workflow3)

MLR_results <- bind_rows(
  fit_resamples(MLR_workflow1, bike_folds) |> collect_metrics() |> mutate(model = "recipe1"),
  fit_resamples(MLR_workflow2, bike_folds) |> collect_metrics() |> mutate(model = "recipe2"),
  fit_resamples(MLR_workflow3, bike_folds) |> collect_metrics() |> mutate(model = "recipe3")
)

MLR_results |> filter(.metric == "rmse")


```

Model with lowest mean (RMSE) is the winning model, which is "Recipe 3"

```{r}

MLR_best_workflow <- MLR_results |> filter(.metric == "rmse") |> arrange(mean) |> slice(1)
MLR_best_workflow

last_mlr <- last_fit(MLR_workflows[[MLR_best_workflow$model]], bike_split, metrics = metric_set(yardstick::rmse,yardstick::mae))
collect_metrics(last_mlr)

```

## Fitting Other Models

Using the 1st recipe from the MLR section, fit the followng models

### Regression Tree

```{r}

tree_spec <- decision_tree(cost_complexity = tune(), tree_depth = tune()) |>
  set_engine("rpart") |>
  set_mode("regression")

tree_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(MLR_recipe1) |>
  add_model(tree_spec)

tree_grid <- tree_workflow |>
  tune_grid(resamples = bike_folds, grid = grid_regular(cost_complexity(), tree_depth(), levels = 5))

tree_best_params <- tree_grid |> select_best(metric = "rmse")
tree_best_params

tree_final_workflow <- tree_workflow |> finalize_workflow(tree_best_params)
tree_final_fit <- tree_final_workflow |> fit(bike_train)

```

### Bagged Tree

```{r}

bag_spec <- bag_tree(cost_complexity = tune(), tree_depth = tune()) |>
  set_engine("rpart", times = 25) |>
  set_mode("regression")

bag_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(MLR_recipe1) |>
  add_model(bag_spec)

bag_grid <- bag_workflow |>
  tune_grid(resamples = bike_folds, grid = grid_regular(cost_complexity(), tree_depth(),levels = 3))
            
bag_best_params <- bag_grid |> select_best(metric = "rmse")
bag_best_params

bag_final_workflow <- bag_workflow |> finalize_workflow(bag_best_params)
bag_final_fit <- bag_final_workflow |> fit(bike_train)


```
### Random Forest

```{r}

rf_spec <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 500) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") |>
  set_mode("regression")

rf_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(MLR_recipe1) |>
  add_model(rf_spec)

rf_grid <- rf_workflow |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = bike_folds,
    grid = grid_regular(mtry(range = c(2,10)), min_n(range = c(2,10)), levels = 3)
  )

rf_best_params <- rf_grid |> select_best(metric = "rmse")

rf_best_params

rf_final_workflow <- rf_workflow |> finalize_workflow(rf_best_params)
rf_final_fit <- rf_final_workflow |> fit(bike_train)


```


## Compare on the test set 


```{r}
last_tree <- last_fit(tree_final_workflow, bike_split, metrics = metric_set(yardstick::rmse,yardstick::mae))
last_bag <- last_fit(bag_final_workflow, bike_split, metrics = metric_set(yardstick::rmse,yardstick::mae))
last_rf <- last_fit(rf_final_workflow, bike_split, metrics = metric_set(yardstick::rmse,yardstick::mae))

test_results <- bind_rows(
  collect_metrics(last_mlr) |> mutate(model = "MLR"),
  collect_metrics(last_tree) |> mutate(model = "Regression Tree"),
  collect_metrics(last_bag) |> mutate(model = "Bagged Tree"),
  collect_metrics(last_rf) |> mutate(model = "Random Forest")
)

rmse_table <- test_results |> filter(.metric == "rmse") |> select(model, rmse = .estimate) |> arrange(rmse)
rmse_table


mae_table <- test_results |> filter(.metric == "mae") |> select(model, mae = .estimate) |> arrange(mae)
mae_table
```

## Overall Best Model - Refit on Entire Data Set 


```{r}

rmse_table
mae_table

best_overall <- rmse_table$model[1]
best_overall

if(best_overall == "MLR") {
  overall_best_workflow <- MLR_workflows[[MLR_best_workflow$model]]
} else if(best_overall == "Regression Tree") {
  overall_best_workflow <- tree_final_workflow
} else if(best_overall == "Bagged Tree") {
  overall_best_workflow <- bag_final_workflow
} else {
  overall_best_workflow <- rf_final_workflow
}

overall_best_fit <- overall_best_workflow |> fit(daily)
overall_best_fit

```
